scope: Foreground Odysseus sword vs Trojan spear/shield; six actors in shared first frame. Technical decode is separate from visual combat acceptance.
review_scope: Sample at 0,0.25,...,4.75,4.958 seconds. Inspect candidate contacts densely at 12fps. Audio is not included in visual scores.

common_combat_scores.contact: 0 no plausible contact;1 one readable exchange;2 at least two readable exchanges
common_combat_scores.separation: 0 lingering glued weapons;1 one clear separation;2 separation and renewed attack
common_combat_scores.reaction: 0 disconnected/absent;1 some recoil;2 visible torso/shield reaction followed by a stabilizing footstep
common_combat_scores.footwork: 0 prolonged standstill;1 some reposition;2 attacking, evading and recovering through leg/hip movement
common_combat_scores.weapon_integrity: 0 swap/disappear or unusable deformation;1 brief uncertainty;2 sword/right hand/empty left and spear/right/shield/left stay credible

production_gate: Readable attack/contact/separation/reaction; stable weapon identity and hands; no material weapon/body discontinuity. New-prompt sequence adherence is separately recorded, never treated as the common score itself.
limits: Manual scores on a short scene and three seeds are descriptive, not universal model rankings; seed numbers do not pair noise across architectures. Sampled review cannot certify every intervening frame.
